baseline_models.mechanism: The line assigns woe to a class defined by declaring a thing or its bearer false, so the focus is active repudiation rather than undifferentiated dishonesty.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood to a thing or person supplies the literal act that defines the addressed class.

changed_reading.after: Woe for those actively treating a claim, report, or bearer as false.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ك ذ ب label in مُكَذِّبِينَ can classify a sustained stance, not only one utterance.
baseline_models.mechanism: The truth-versus-falsehood branch includes falsehood in speech and action, allowing the plural label to name conduct that practically contradicts truth as well as verbal denial.

activation_trace.role: Opposition to truth in speech or action broadens denial from an assertion into an enacted stance.

changed_reading.before: The recipients merely say something untrue.
changed_reading.after: The recipients occupy and enact a position opposed to truth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun retains the ك ذ ب branch in which a charge proves true by being carried through or false by failing.
baseline_models.mechanism: On a performance axis, denial treats an announced charge as something that will not complete its course; this is branch-distant but still attached to the focus root.

activation_trace.role: A charge proving true or failing supplies a performance test for what the deniers reject.

changed_reading.before: The deniers pronounce a message false.
changed_reading.after: The deniers stake themselves on the announced charge failing to be carried through.

context_deltas.mechanism: The identical line repeatedly closes unlike proof and judgment blocks, then 77:29 turns the class label into the denied object toward which they must proceed. The refrain therefore functions as a recurrent test of the same repudiating stance across changing evidence.

activation_trace.role: The focus class is literally constituted by assigning falsehood to a report or its bearer.
The same falsehood-attribution image at an earlier refrain establishes recurrence of one diagnostic label.
The charge-proving or charge-failing image turns what was denied into an outcome now tested by compelled arrival.

structural_cues: 77:29 immediately follows the focus and commands movement toward what had been denied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrence, changing preceding blocks, and the shift to the denied object; I infer that each refrain is a diagnostic checkpoint. A live alternative is that repetition is emphatic closure without a testing function.

changed_reading.before: A one-time sentence pronounced after the earth scene.
changed_reading.after: A recurring seal that retests the same denial after each new evidentiary domain.

context_deltas.mechanism: Promise or threat is fixed to an appointment, lands as an established event, reaches its temporal limit, and becomes an adjudication separating truth from falsehood. This makes يَوْمَئِذٍ in the focus a precise realization point rather than a vague future marker.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood attribution anchors the people whose rejected announcement reaches its appointed test.
An appointment fixing a promise in time or place supplies the scheduled content behind 'that day.'
Falling and becoming fixed supplies the transition from announcement to realized event.
Setting a thing by a time or limit makes the realization bounded rather than indefinite.
The day as an event of severity gives the deictic day experiential force.
The terminal point of an appointed duration supplies the end of postponement.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the function performed when the appointment arrives.

structural_cues: 77:7 asserts that what is promised will occur; 77:11-14 asks the appointed day and names it the Day of Separation.
The focus construction يَوْمَئِذٍ points back into this temporal-adjudicative chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, occurrence, timing, terminal limit, and separating judgment; I infer a single realization sequence terminating in the focus day. These may instead be parallel descriptions without a staged causal order.

changed_reading.before: Woe on an unspecified future day.
changed_reading.after: Woe at the fixed point when the denied announcement becomes an irreversible adjudicative event.

context_deltas.mechanism: A dispatch goes out, opens and spreads, distinguishes, casts a reminder, and reaches the paired outcomes of completed excuse and warning. Denial becomes the terminal rejection of an already completed delivery chain, not an opinion formed without notice.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a report or bearer false supplies the rejecting act at the end of the chain.
Dispatch and outward movement supply the chain's initiating transmission.
Opening, spreading, and branching supply distribution beyond the initial dispatch.
Distinguishing two things supplies intelligible differentiation within what is delivered.
Casting a thing until it is laid down supplies the transfer into the recipient's field.
A reminder that causes recollection identifies the delivered content's prompting function.
Giving full notice and reaching the limit supplies completion sufficient to remove lack-of-notice as a defense.
Warning that awakens caution supplies the delivered reminder's prospective effect.

structural_cues: 77:1-6 forms a linked participial sequence ending in remembrance, excuse, or warning.
The opening agents remain grammatically unspecified in the packet text.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered branch images and the sequence ending in reminder; I infer an information-delivery pipeline whose rejection defines the focus class. A live alternative is that the early agents are physical forces and only the final image is informational.

changed_reading.before: People independently decide that a claim is false.
changed_reading.after: Terminal recipients negate a dispatched, differentiated, and fully delivered warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first communities perish, later ones follow them, and the same action is applied to offenders. The plural focus label therefore names a repeatable cross-generational role in a serial consequence pattern rather than only the immediate audience.

activation_trace.role: The active falsehood-attribution label supplies the role that can recur in distinct cohorts.
Falling into destruction supplies the realized consequence in the first cohort.
Beginning and precedence identify an earlier cohort rather than a unique case.
Succession one after another supplies the serial link between cohorts.
Laterness after the first supplies the second position in the recurring pattern.
Producing an action supplies the repeated operation applied across cases.
Guilt and offense identify the recurrent class by culpable relation rather than genealogy.

structural_cues: 77:16-18 explicitly moves from the first to the later and states that the same action is done to offenders.
The refrain at 77:19 closes this serial statement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies first/later succession and repeated action; I infer that مُكَذِّبِينَ is a role occupied across generations. The alternative is a narrower warning by historical analogy to the immediate audience.

changed_reading.before: The focus targets one present group.
changed_reading.after: The focus names a recurrent denial-position whose consequences are serially reproduced across cohorts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation proceeds through a stable repository and measured limit, while earth gathers living and dead, mountains anchor, and sweet water is delivered. Because the focus immediately seals the second material block, denial becomes an embodied contradiction: recipients depend on an ordered containing and sustaining system while enacting opposition to what it indicates.

activation_trace.role: Falsehood opposed to truth in speech or action allows material dependence and enacted denial to be compared.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the originating material process.
Fixity and settlement supply the stable holding phase of generation.
Managing by measure and consideration supplies ordered limitation rather than accidental duration.
Gathering and gripping within a container makes earth a holding system for opposed life states.
Firm rooting supplies environmental stabilization within the containing system.
Quenching the drinker supplies active delivery of sustaining provision.
Sweet fresh water specifies the usable quality of the provision immediately before the focus.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 is a generation-and-measure block closed by the refrain at 77:24.
77:25-27 is a containing-and-provision block closed directly by the focus at 77:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies generation, measurement, containment, stabilization, and provision; I infer that lived dependence functions as a counter-witness to denial. The alternative is that these details demonstrate power and benefit without making dependence itself accusatory.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns an abstract verbal refusal.
changed_reading.after: The focus exposes a practical contradiction between denying and continuously inhabiting the measured, containing, and sustaining order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Separating judgment is followed by loss of speech, denial of permission to excuse, collective assembly, and a failed invitation to countermaneuver. The refrain becomes a procedural closure of the speech-act that had declared the message false.

activation_trace.role: Declaring a report or bearer false supplies the speech-act that adjudication finally closes.
Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the proceeding's adjudicative criterion.
Literal speech supplies the capacity that is removed from the former deniers.
Permission or authorization supplies the procedural access that is withheld.
Excuse and exculpation supply the defense they are not allowed to advance.
A day or summons gathering people supplies the collective hearing setting.
Stratagem and contrivance supply the challenged but unavailable counter-procedure.

structural_cues: 77:35-36 removes speech and excuse, 77:37 repeats the refrain, and 77:38-39 gathers all parties and challenges any scheme.
The Day of Separation is named before and within these scenes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies separating judgment, silence, withheld permission, excuse, assembly, and challenge; I infer a procedural closure of denial. A live alternative is a punitive tableau with no courtroom sequence implied.

changed_reading.before: The refrain only threatens pain for a wrong belief.
changed_reading.after: The refrain marks the point at which the deniers' contesting speech loses procedural standing and no defense can reopen it.

context_deltas.mechanism: A spoken command to bow is met by refusal to bow, bracketed by two occurrences of the refrain. The charge branch of ك ذ ب is thereby activated as an enactment test: denial appears when received speech is not carried through in bodily response.

activation_trace.role: A charge proving true through completion or false through failure supplies the focus reading's performance axis.
Uttered speech supplies the received command whose practical truth is tested.
Bending and lowering the head supplies the concrete act that is commanded and withheld.
Humility and submission supply the social posture refused along with the bodily motion.

structural_cues: 77:47 gives the refrain, 77:48 states command and nonperformance, and 77:49 gives the refrain again.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies command, bodily act, refusal, and bracketing refrains; I infer that nonperformance is practical takdhib and makes the charge fail at the recipient. The alternative is that refusal to bow is a separate offense merely placed beside denial.

changed_reading.before: Denial is principally a proposition about whether the message is true.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also exposed by whether received speech is carried into embodied submission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final question combines a renewed report, temporal succession, and assent that settles the heart. After the last refrain, denial becomes an epistemic terminal: rejecting this discourse leaves no later report able to establish trust.

activation_trace.role: Attributing falsehood to the report supplies the rejection whose downstream consequence is tested.
Speech renewed as report or news supplies the possible successor disclosure.
After in contrast to before supplies the succession test posed to any later discourse.
Assent in which the heart becomes settled supplies the trust response no successor report can produce.

structural_cues: 77:49 is the final refrain and 77:50 immediately asks what discourse after this they will trust.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successor discourse and settled assent; I infer that repeated takdhib closes the route by which a later report could restore trust. The alternative is a claim of this discourse's unrivaled authority without a psychological hardening mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The deniers reject one report while other disclosures remain conceptually open.
changed_reading.after: Their rejection is terminal: after this fully delivered discourse, no successor report can become heart-settling testimony.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers the focus branch of deceptive cloth from appearance into a moral-spatial analogy. It remains anchored in focus ك ذ ب B009 and is sharpened by the non-protective 'shade' at 77:30-31 versus protective shade at 77:41; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory functional image, never as a lexical replacement for مُكَذِّبِينَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's branch in which a patterned cloth lies through its condition or appearance.

activation_trace.role: An appearance that deceives by its state supplies the focus-anchored image of functional falsehood.
Shade as shelter and protection supplies the function apparently promised by the destination's name.
Sufficiency supplies the protective performance explicitly absent from that shade.
Protective shade in the contrasting scene supplies the functionally true counterpart.
Warding off harm supplies the successful protective relation absent from the false shelter.

changed_reading.before: Denial is a false statement about reality.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be imaged as investing in a shelter whose name and appearance promise cover while its failed function gives that promise the lie.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is surprising because it uses the non-dominant split mapping from و ع د to ع د د and therefore cannot establish a lexical sense of the source word. It remains formally anchored in the focus's repeated يَوْمَئِذٍ construction and exact refrain recurrence; downstream prose should qualify it as a counted-time or rehearsal image only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The deictic day in the focus line as repeated with the same ك ذ ب class label.

activation_trace.role: The recurring falsehood-attribution class keeps the counted subject stable across refrain instances.
The non-dominant image of time's count and recurrence supplies an exploratory rehearsal counter for the promise.
A duration of time supplies the temporal field through which the repeated formula advances.
An earlier exact class label supplies a resolvable recurrence before the focus instance.

changed_reading.before: 'That day' points once to a future event.
changed_reading.after: Each refrain can be heard as another counted rehearsal that advances the hearer toward the appointed day it names.

strongest_changes: Exact recurrence turns the focus from a local curse into a diagnostic checkpoint across unlike proof and judgment blocks.
The promise, occurrence, timing, limit, and separation chain makes يَوْمَئِذٍ the fixed realization of what denial expected not to arrive.
The generation, containment, stabilization, and water sequence makes denial an embodied contradiction within a sustaining order.
Speech closure, refused bowing, and the final no-successor-discourse question extend denial from proposition into procedure, action, and trust.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package exposed the exact refrain's placement after transmission, cosmic, historical, generative, terrestrial, punitive, contrastive, and response scenes. That distribution allowed one focus line to retain several mechanisms without collapsing them into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The opening feminine participles do not identify their agents, so the completed-delivery model should not decide whether they are messengers, forces, or both.
The charge-performance and deceptive-appearance branches are live but more distant than direct falsehood attribution and should not replace it.
The counted-refrain outlier depends on a non-dominant split mapping and is a formal activation, not lexical evidence.
